title: USF-174 composed search provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: Search provider parity is split by semantic requirement. In-memory search is accepted only where service catalogue authority permits it and is not equivalent to Meilisearch composed provider semantics.

searchProviderDisposition.riskStatement: Meilisearch service semantics could be claimed from hermetic in-memory search proof or from service catalogue presence without SDK-backed composed provider evidence.
searchProviderDisposition.treatment: Defer Meilisearch SDK/client selection, adapter implementation, indexing, query, ranking, filtering, async indexing, deletion, retention, reindex, readiness retry, failure-mode, audit, teardown, supplier, incident, privacy, and provider proof to USF-199.
searchProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: USF-174 records the bounded disposition gate, non-equivalence boundary, runtime manifest deferral, enterprise evidence rows, validator coverage, and planted defects only.

inMemorySubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: In-memory search proof is not equivalent to Meilisearch composed provider indexing, ranking, filtering, async indexing visibility, persistence, deletion, retention, reindex, SDK/client, readiness retry, provider failure-mode, or wire/API behaviour.
scopeCovered: tenant-safe hermetic search indexing proof where semantically permitted
repository search capability proof posture from USF-164
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove Meilisearch adapter binding
does not prove Meilisearch indexing or query compatibility
does not prove ranking, filtering, async indexing, deletion, retention, or reindex behaviour
does not prove Meilisearch SDK/client selection or dependency posture
does not prove provider failure modes, retry, timeout, audit operation evidence, or teardown
does not prove vector, embedding, AI, RAG, live-provider, test, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full React parity readiness

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records full-text-search-meilisearch-deferred as deferred evidence-only support linked to the Meilisearch service catalogue row.

semanticProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Hermetic in-memory indexing proof is not Meilisearch indexing proof.
In-memory search result ordering and filtering do not prove Meilisearch ranking, filtering, tokenization, or query compatibility.
USF-174 does not prove provider-visible async indexing, delete propagation, retention, purge, or reindex behaviour.
